scope: adapter details fixed after input/budget freeze, before candidate execution
prepared_pair: original five-tuple, retained identity binds actual ordered mesh pair
intersection: original five positional parameters plus optional plane_distances=(da,db), missing side None computed once
coverage_counter: subtree_pruned_pairs counts covered Cartesian pairs, not actual visits
closed_candidate_tree: separate reversible integer-frame primary tree may serve self/cross; world roots remain for surface/point/ray; numeric overflow must fall back to world candidate coverage
missing_counters: not_emitted or not_measured; never replace missing by zero
